structured.answer: According to the site, the cheapest place is פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500", and you would have about 72,104 ₪ after ten years from 60,000 ₪ put in. But I don't know פסגות and I wouldn't move anything before I ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: 'סכום היום' started at 10,000 and I had to notice that and change it to 0 myself. Before that, the first big number I saw was 86,492.
It gave an amount but didn't name the bank or the fund. I had to scroll to find out who 'הזול' was.

stuck.where: Fees bar chart and the fund list with red minus amounts
stuck.why: There were many colours and red minus numbers ('−31 ₪', '−577 ₪'). It frightened me and I stopped there.

used: Title 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Middle box: 72,104 ₪ 'נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס'
Account card 'פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ' and fund 'ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500'
Ranked list on the right: 1 פסגות 72,104, 2 לאומי 69,758, 3 הבינלאומי 68,953, then מסד, וואן זירו, הפועלים
skimmed: Coloured bar chart 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים'
Fund list on the left with tags
skipped: 'תשואה בשנה' 7% (I left it as it was)
Tags such as צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט"ח
'לא בחישוב' notes on the bank rows
unsure_meaning: קרן מחקה, קרן סל, צוברת, עסקת החלף, דמי משמרת, נאמן
'הזוג' / 'בחרו את הזוג הזה': a pair of what?
Red minus amounts like '−31 ₪' in the column 'לעומת הבחירה'
Whether 7% a year is something promised or just a guess
not_found: Any word on whether this is safe compared with a deposit
Whether my own bank's adviser would charge me
would_change: Start 'סכום היום' at 0, or ask for it first
Put the bank and fund name inside the main result box
Use a light background with fewer colours; the dark screen with pale grey writing is hard to read
Explain the words מחקה and צוברת in plain Hebrew
Don't show red minus numbers in the list; they look like losses
